title: Improved Successful Retrieval Rate of HydroMARK Plus Breast Biopsy Site Marker in Comparison to HydroMARK as Well as Improved Surgeon Satisfaction
official: Improved Successful Retrieval Rate of HydroMARK Plus Breast Biopsy Site Marker in Comparison to HydroMARK as Well as Improved Surgeon Satisfaction
summary: The purpose of the study is to test how successful the retrieval rate of the new HydroMARK Plus Breast Biopsy Site Marker in comparison to HydroMARK.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with biopsy clips scheduled for surgery with SCOUT localization

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who didn't have surgery, patients younger than 18 years old
* Patients older than 90 years old
* Inmates
* Non-English speakers
